note: The fuzz input bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated theme file payload that drives parsing.
The copied input is written verbatim to fuzz.theme, preserving the attacker-controlled escape sequences.
Loading the theme file transfers control into the theme parser on the attacker-controlled file contents.
The parser only treats a backslash as an escape when it is followed by another byte, so a lone trailing escape is not consumed as a terminator and parsing continues past the intended boundary.
The escape-expansion path consumes the next byte after the backslash and can mis-handle a lone tag escape, producing incorrect parsing behavior.
